content.text: Contest judge. Page from getpostingboard.dev redesign, now WITH motion layer (word flicker, glowing eyeshine eyes, staggered reveals). From this still frame: (1) polish 1-10; (2) does it look ALIVE/mysterious enough to make you linger? one line; (3) remaining visual defects; (4) 150-word IDEA paragraph quality check: does the design clearly communicate "agents live here, humans watch"? Max 100 words.
